0:
current=$(cat /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces)
if [ "$current" -lt 15000 ]; then
  echo "raising user.max_user_namespaces from $current to 15000"
  echo 15000 > /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces
else
  echo "user.max_user_namespaces=$current, leaving alone"
fi

echo "Cleaning up images on node $(hostname)" &&
apk add --no-cache curl &&
curl -LO https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/cri-tools/releases/download/v1.31.1/crictl-v1.31.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz &&
tar -xvf crictl-* &&
mv crictl /usr/local/bin/ &&
crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock rmi --prune &&
echo "Cleanup completed successfully on node $(hostname)" &&
sleep 5 &&
exit 0
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 && if sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding; then sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1; fi
